# Workspace map

The code graph and the two workflows that change it. Read after `CLAUDE.md` when a task touches more than one folder.

## Contents

- [Code](#code)
- [Dependency graph](#dependency-graph)
- [Workflows](#workflows)
- [State](#state)

## Code

| Folder | One job |
|---|---|
| `crates/hip-sys` | raw FFI to the HIP runtime (and rocBLAS) |
| `crates/hip-rt` | safe host API: device, module, buffers, streams, events |
| `crates/hip-tile` | the tile library used inside kernels (also ABI types on the host) |
| `crates/hip-tile-macros` | `#[kernel]`: device entry point + typed host launcher |
| `crates/hip-tile-build` | `build.rs` helper: device build of `kernels`, ELF embedding, rpath |
| `kernels` | all GPU kernels (built for the device and, for launchers, the host) |
| `apps/runner` | kernel tests and benchmarks |
| `crates/hip_darknet` | Darknet YOLO port: loader, CPU reference, decode, GPU executor, CLI |
| `xtask` | `cargo xtask <task>`: project automation (`train_hip_legogears`) |
| `docs` | images for the README |

## Dependency graph

```
hip-sys ──▶ hip-rt ──▶ (launchers generated by hip-tile-macros)
hip-tile ◀── kernels ──▶ hip-tile-macros
kernels (device ELF) ◀── hip-tile-build ◀── build.rs of apps/runner, crates/hip_darknet
apps/runner, crates/hip_darknet ──▶ hip-rt, kernels (host launchers)
```

Two `build.rs` files reference `../../kernels`; moving `kernels` or the two consumers breaks the device build.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Unit of work | Stages |
|---|---|---|
| `workflows/add-kernel/` | one kernel or tile op | 01_spec → 02_kernel → 03_parity → 04_bench |
| `workflows/port-darknet-model/` | one Darknet model (cfg + weights) | 01_cfg-cpu → 02_gpu-ops → 03_executor → 04_bench-docs |
| `workflows/train-darknet-model/` | one model + dataset, trained from scratch | 01_train-semantics → 02_cpu-backward → 03_gpu-backward → 04_executor → 05_cli-checkpoints → 06_run → 07_bench-docs |

Each stage folder holds only its contract (`CONTEXT.md`). Each run lives in `runs/<name>/` and gets one file per finished stage, named after the stage (`01_spec.md`, …). New runs start as a copy of `_templates/kernel/`, `_templates/port-run/` or `_templates/train-run/`.

The training goal, its decisions and acceptance numbers live in `docs/ROADMAP.md`.

## State

- Workflow status = which stage files exist in `workflows/*/runs/<name>/`.
- Branch progress and corrections: `tasks/main/todo.md`, `tasks/main/lessons.md`.
- Settled facts: `_shared/` only.
